blocks.text: The train follows the Urubamba River between steep green slopes, then a bus takes you up to Machu Picchu. Stone terraces, stairways and walls follow the contours of the mountain, with deep valleys and Andean peaks all around.

blocks.text: The road from Cusco to Puno crosses high plains dotted with herds of llamas and alpacas, small villages and ancient sites. The final part of the route takes you to Lake Titicaca and the Uros and Taquile islands at more than 3,800 m above sea level.
